yt_title: How to sort your Instagram saves without logging in
caption:
No login. Your saves. Sorted.

SaveSort never asks for your Instagram password. It reads Instagram's own data export, opens only the saved posts file inside, and sorts it in your browser. Nothing gets uploaded.

How to sort your Instagram saved reels: download your Instagram data, tick only Saved, drop the zip into SaveSort. Runs in your browser, nothing gets uploaded.

What's your number? Find out free, link in bio.

Sorty's voice is AI. The saves and numbers are real.
